scripts.setup: npm install && mkdir -p public/fonts && curl -L -o public/fonts/NotoSansJP-Regular.ttf 'https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/raw/main/Sans/OTF/Japanese/NotoSansCJKjp-Regular.otf' && curl -L -o public/fonts/NotoSansJP-Bold.ttf 'https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/raw/main/Sans/OTF/Japanese/NotoSansCJKjp-Bold.otf' && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev
